PLT-005Implemented

Verified organisation admission, bootstrap ownership, product/module selection, tenant provisioning, and readiness

Core · Platform & Tenancy · Owner: Platform Engineering & Security

Acceptance boundary

Automated tests prove verified two-person admission, a quarantined tenant, single-use MFA bootstrap ownership, dependency-ordered provisioning, compensation and fail-closed activation readiness.

Current maturity and gap

The governed platform capability is implemented, but no commercial admission or cloud-control integration is live. Production remains blocked until the applicable INT-ADM adapters, direct-authority sources, contracts, credentials and witnessed UAT are certified.

Dependencies

INT-ADM-01 through INT-ADM-10 for production external services Platform identity and audit controls Tenant registry and provisioning saga

Review currency

Last reviewed 2026-07-15. Revalidate when implementation, policy, provider or operating evidence changes.

Implementation and verification evidence 3
  • codepackages/core/src/platform/organisation-signup.js

    Fail-closed organisation admission, representative verification, quarantined tenant reservation and bootstrap-owner handoff.

  • testtests/organisation-signup-api.test.js

    HTTP acceptance coverage for two-person admission, single-use MFA ownership, provisioning-only access and activation blockers.

  • testtests/tenant-provisioning-saga.test.js

    Executable provisioning, compensation, reconciliation and evidence-bound handover coverage.
